Source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/content/Backgrounds/Topography/Topography.jsx
License: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/LICENSE.md
Retrieved 2026-11-09. R52 adapts the noise/relief field into building heights and the contour-stroke logic into facade materials. No standalone Background Studio tool is redistributed.
Also covered: r52/web/js/vendor/topography.js, a vanilla-JS port of the same Topography component (commit b0422bb475ac9ec1fe1680290970494ceff5d4eb, git blob aa0b5740a1246b79dbac366978989e2da8f19595) with the preset values from src/demo/Backgrounds/presets/Topography.js. It is used only as the R52 overview widget (preset "Sonar") and is not redistributed as a standalone component.
